description: Delete a workflow from the API key's workspace, for everyone: it leaves every list and the gallery, can no longer be run, and cannot be restored. Runs already started finish, and copies made from it keep working. With a team project's key this includes teammates' workflows. Without `confirm: true` this only describes what would be deleted; ask the user, then call again with `confirm: true`.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved the deletion.

slug.description: The full workflow slug or the workflow page URL.

name: delete_workflow
title: Delete a Wiro workflow
